description: Commit messages (or paths with search_in=paths) by keywords, newest first: every word, case-insensitive (git log -i --grep per word). Each commit: sha (cite it), commit_id, message, author, date, people credited, mail_refs (up to 5 messages that refer to it {inbox, message_id, subject, url, how_it_refers: discussion-trailer, committers-announcement or mentions-hash}). A SHA or 7+ hex prefix returns that commit. Details: commit_history.
name: git_search
